Right-handed, Y-up, metres · +X east · +Z south · origin = settlement datum · drawn from the blueprint data · names are working placeholders

Logarithmic radial scale: distance r ∝ log(1 + d / 50 m). Bearings are true. Renderers draw distant places as layered silhouettes at these bearings; heights and distances drive impostor scale and fog.

Frontier keeps exist toward every neighbouring nation; the one toward the rival house's nation flies its colours (state-driven). Territories are indicative claims. Inter-nation bearings are working placeholders, not canon geography.
